page: Microsoft Azure E128-64ads_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Eadsv7 family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, delivering 64 dedicated vCPUs across 32 physical cores with a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The system features 1024.0 GB of RAM, translating to a high memory-to-core ratio of 16.0 GB per core. It includes 7559 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage.

Benchmark results place this server in the top tier for single-core and multi-core CPU performance, as demonstrated by Geekbench and stress-ng tests. It also achieves top-tier results in database operations, software compilation, and text processing. Memory bandwidth is strong, reaching 206.52 GB/sec for large-block read operations. For LLM inference workloads, the server processes small model prompts at 5186.0 tokens/sec and generates text at 399.01 tokens/sec, maintaining top-tier performance.

Given its high memory density and substantial local NVMe SSD capacity, the E128-64ads_v7 offers high qualitative cost efficiency for resource-intensive workloads that require large in-memory datasets without the need for dedicated GPU acceleration. The lack of a GPU limits its utility for heavy deep learning training, but it is highly suited for large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, data analytics, and enterprise-grade web serving.
